items.contentSnippet:
I built Isolade because I could not find an open-source, local-first workbench that runs coding agents in microVMs.
The two pieces already exist individually. There are plenty of options for both agent management (Conductor, Herdr, Omnigent) and microVM isolation (Docker Sandboxes, Firecracker, SmolVM). However, I did not find a project that combined them into one unified product.

items.title: Show HN: Draftlight – AI that makes you a better writer (leaves writing to you)
items.contentSnippet: Hi, as I've recently noticed, AI isn't making me a better writer or thinker, so I've decided to take a step back. No AI for writing, or at least AI shouldn't write for me. But since English isn't my first language, I created a small helper for myself. It's a markdown editor where you can ask AI for guidance and comments on the clarity and correctness of the whole text and each paragraph individually. The final result is still human-written (also according to pangram). For now, it's free to use.
